title: QR label endpoint generates scannable code for asset tag
objective: Verify GET /assets/:uuid/label returns a QR (SVG/PNG per D-14) encoding the asset tag + deep link (/scan?tag=...), authorized per scope.
preconditions: Operator session; seeded asset with tag.
steps: GET /api/v1/assets/<uuid>/label; verify content type and payload.
Decode QR content (test library or manual scan) and verify it encodes the tag + deep-link URL.
expected_result: Label endpoint returns SVG or PNG with correct encoded payload (tag + /scan?tag= deep link); unauthorized → 401/403/404 per scope rules; label generation audited if documented.

title: Printable label page — single and batch
objective: Verify /assets/[id]/label renders a print-ready 50×25mm label (tag human-readable + QR) and batch print works from the register selection if delivered.
test_data: single asset; selection of 5 assets for batch
steps: Open label page; verify layout contains tag text (monospace) + QR image; invoke print and inspect print stylesheet (no app chrome).
Batch-select assets in register (if feature delivered); generate combined labels.
expected_result: Label matches print spec (dimensions via CSS, human-readable tag, QR); print view excludes navigation; batch produces one label per selected asset; feature flag/absence documented if batch deferred.
automation_status: partially manual (print inspection), Playwright for DOM

title: Scan flow — known tag resolves to asset; manual entry fallback
objective: Verify /scan?tag=<known> resolves to the asset (detail or scan result panel) and manual tag entry works identically to camera scanning.
preconditions: Browser; operator signed in; known seeded tag. (Camera scanning simulated — no physical camera in CI.)
steps: Navigate to /scan?tag=<known tag>; verify resolution to the correct asset with clear action options.
Open /scan; use manual entry with the same tag; verify identical result.
Verify Employee role gets lookup-level access only (per route table) while Operator gets actions.
expected_result: Deep link + manual entry both resolve deterministically to the same asset; result panel shows identity (tag, name, status) and permitted actions only; role-appropriate capabilities enforced server-side.

title: Unknown/malformed code — clear non-destructive result
objective: Verify scanning/entering an unknown or malformed tag yields a clear 'not found' result with next actions (register new asset if permitted) and no data mutation.
test_data: unknown tag 'AST-999999'; malformed strings ('<script>alert(1)</script>', 500-char string, SQL probe)
steps: Enter each value in manual entry (and as /scan?tag= param).
expected_result: Clear non-destructive 'no asset found' messaging; malformed input safely handled (no execution, no 500); offer to register a new asset shown only to roles with create permission; nothing created/changed by lookups.
